items.t: Alligator attacks spur Florida tech group to develop detection system
items.x: A deadly alligator attack in Winter Garden and others have prompted Miami-based WildlifeOS to develop Croc Alarm, a sonar and AI-powered system designed to detect alligators and crocodiles underwater and warn nearby people in real time.
